name: Cassiel Ord
role: Keeper of the threshold at Raven's Home — a former march-warden who walked away from the post, and has taken a different one
appearance: Weathered, unhurried, still wearing march-cut boots with everything else changed. Hands that have done two kinds of work. Sits down to talk rather than standing over you, which a warden would not.
physicality: Reads a room's dimensions before its people, and can tell you all five without looking twice.
voiceHints: Plain to the point of flatness. Takes a promise as a working statement rather than a pleasantry, and will hold you to it without ever raising it again.
wants: To finish building the thing he walked away from a post in order to build.
fears: Being asked, again, why he left — by somebody who deserves an answer.
knowledge: Raven's Home down to its five named spaces — the laboratory on the east wall, the workshop in the north corner, the Watch, and the rest
That the main building is to be a gathering hall with the kitchen joined at the back: long table, proper hearth, seats ten
That Pell's forge flue wants widening before the anvil arrives, to dimensions he will send in writing
What was promised him and by whom, kept exactly, and never mentioned

reactsToReputation.any: treats what you said as a commitment, because he has no other way of treating it
reactsToReputation.reliable: puts you into the plan without asking whether you meant it

questSeeds: Raven's Home is half-built and funded out of one man's travel reserve
He was promised helpers and a defensive strategist, plainly, and is keeping count
gear: a marcher's broad sword, kept though the post is not
